dark-warning: It is pitch dark. You are likely to put a foot somewhere you cannot take it back from.
dark-death: You take one more confident step into the dark. The dark, which has been doing this for a very long time, does not step aside.
rat-death: The rat decides the question of who is the smaller animal here, and settles it quickly.
packrat-taunt: Something small goes past your ankles at speed. Your hands are lighter than they were, and somewhere ahead of you in the dark, a small professional is not looking back.
ledge-death: You jump. For a moment it is going remarkably well. The daylight is closer than it has ever been, and then it is much further away than it has ever been, and then the matter is out of your hands.
zeeble-descend-text: You say the word. The hill considers it, decides not to argue, and puts you somewhere else.
zeeble-ascend-text: You say the word. The stone forgets the distance between here and the sky, and by the time it remembers, you are standing in it.
victory-text: You set the last of it on the shelf and step back. The plank holds. The shed smells of hot metal and, now, of having been right about something. Somewhere under the hill, a small professional is going to be extremely annoyed.
